name: Ring of Engulfing
body:
Aura moderate transmutation; CL 7th; Slot ring; Weight –

DESCRIPTION

This ring appears to be a ring of evasion. Whenever the wearer must make a Reflex saving throw to avoid full damage from an area of effect spell or attack, the saving throw is made with a -10 penalty. If the saving throw fails by 5 or more, the damage inflicted on the wearer is increased by 50% as if the spell were empowered.

This ring can only be removed by a remove curse followed by cat’s grace. Doing so renders the ring non-magical.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Magic Items ring of evasion

Identification DC 32
False Identification DC 22
